tagline.en: Malaysia's largest network: 95-country roaming passes, free SMS reception in China
tagline.zh: 马来西亚最大运营商：95国漫游包，中国漫游免费收短信

description.en: CelcomDigi prepaid (the classic "purple SIM") runs on Malaysia's largest merged Celcom-Digi network. The 30-Day Unlimited roaming pass (RM118, 3GB daily high-speed + unlimited 1Mbps) covers 95 countries including China, Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, US and UK. Receiving SMS while roaming in mainland China is free with zero balance — its core keep-alive value. Since the 2022-2023 merger, everything moved to celcomdigi.com, the CelcomDigi app, and *118#/*124# USSD menus.
description.zh: CelcomDigi 预付卡（经典"紫卡"）运行在 Celcom 与 Digi 合并后的马来西亚最大网络上。30 天无限漫游包（RM118，每日 3GB 高速+无限 1Mbps）覆盖含中国、香港、日本、韩国、英美在内的 95 国。在中国大陆漫游接收短信免费、零余额即可收到——这是它保号场景的核心价值。2022-2023 合并后，所有操作迁移到 celcomdigi.com、CelcomDigi app 与 *118#/*124# 指令。

details.en:
Celcom (founded 1988, Malaysia's oldest operator) merged with Digi to form CelcomDigi Berhad (reg. 425190-X), the country's largest carrier — 20M+ subscribers, 98% population coverage. Old purple prepaid SIMs keep working in the new system.

**China roaming in practice**: SMS reception is free on insertion; data attaches to China Mobile / China Unicom 4G (5G requires prior local Malaysian activation). The classic APN trap survives: Androids defaulting to a "celcom4g" APN stick on EDGE — switch APN to celcom3g and toggle airplane mode. Voice is expensive (RM6/min incoming, up to RM12/min outgoing): treat it as a data-and-SMS card.

**2026 roaming passes (one-time, prepaid-eligible)**: RM28/3 days 4GB (SG/ID/TH only); RM48/3 days, RM58/7 days (2GB daily), RM98/14 days, RM118/30 days (3GB daily, unlimited 1Mbps) — all covering 95 countries, each with 15 min voice and AeroMobile in-flight roaming. Postpaid 5G 120+ subscribers get 50% off and monthly options (RM40/30GB 3-country, RM70/80GB 95-country); prepaid is one-time-pass only.

**Keep-alive rules changed post-merger**. Reload extends validity by amount: RM5=5d, RM10=10d, RM30=30d, RM50=50d, RM100=100d (Digi side: 120d). After credit expiry a 50-day grace period allows top-up only. Super Long Life extensions via *118#: RM1/1d, RM2/3d, RM8/15d (Celcom) and RM108/365d on Digi plans. Credit caps at RM1,000; reloads carry a 6% service tax.

**eKYC is mandatory**: passport photo + liveness check at activation. Buy from sellers who complete registration with your own passport where possible — pre-registered SIMs carry reclaim risk. An un-eKYC'd SIM shows no signal in China; *124# responding confirms registration took. Sources: celcomdigi.com roaming pages + third-party tests, verified 2026-08-22.
details.zh:
Celcom（1988 年成立，马来西亚最老牌运营商）与 Digi 合并组建 CelcomDigi Berhad（注册号 425190-X），为马来西亚用户量最大的运营商——2000 万+用户、98% 人口覆盖。老紫卡在新体系下继续可用。

**中国漫游实测**：插卡即免费收短信；数据走中国移动/联通 4G（5G 需先在马来西亚本地开通激活）。经典 APN 坑依旧存在：安卓默认 "celcom4g" APN 会卡 EDGE——改成 celcom3g 再开关飞行模式即可。通话很贵（接听 RM6/分钟、拨打最高 RM12/分钟），把它当流量+收码卡用。

**2026 漫游包（一次性，预付可买）**：RM28/3天 4GB（仅新印泰）；RM48/3天、RM58/7天（每日 2GB）、RM98/14天、RM118/30天（每日 3GB+无限 1Mbps）——均覆盖 95 国，各含 15 分钟通话与 AeroMobile 机上漫游。后付 5G 120 及以上套餐半价且有月付选项（RM40/30GB 三国、RM70/80GB 95国）；预付只能买一次性包。

**保号规则合并后已改**。充值按额延期：RM5=5天、RM10=10天、RM30=30天、RM50=50天、RM100=100天（Digi 侧 120 天）。余额过期后有 50 天宽限期（仅可充值）。Super Long Life 延期走 *118#：RM1/1天、RM2/3天、RM8/15天（Celcom 侧），Digi 套餐另有 RM108/365天。余额上限 RM1,000；充值含 6% 服务税。

**eKYC 强制实名**：激活需护照拍照+人脸识别。尽量选用自己的护照完成注册的渠道——预实名的卡有被原持有人找回的风险。未完成 eKYC 的卡在国内无信号；*124# 能回即实名成功。来源：celcomdigi.com 漫游页+第三方实测，核验于 2026-08-22。
